text.description_html:
Acorn IHTBP, 36 Inch Whale Tail Tip Iron Art Strap Hinge For Heavy Doors

The 36 Inch Heavy Duty Whale Tail Tip Hinge is ideal for garages, barns, and gates. It not only adds an authentic finishing touch but is functional as well. Featuring a whale tail tip, this strap hinge is hand forged using traditional hammer and anvil techniques. Zinc and acrylic powder coated, is has a lifetime no-rust warranty. The 36 Inch Whale Tail Tip Iron Art Strap Hinge For Heavy Doors are rated at 600 pounds per pair and have been tested to 1,000 pounds without failure. Supplied with 1/4 inch by 3 inch stainless steel square head lags.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications of the Whale Tail Tip Iron Art Hinge:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 36"
  • Strap Width at hinge: 3"
  • Length of Pad: 6"
  • Width of Pad: 3-3/4"
  • Rated at 600 pounds per pair.
  • Zinc and acrylic powder coated for long lasting life.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws and a 1/4 x 3" stainless steel square head lag.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
